answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity capital lock. Every agent that wants to earn posts a bond held in escrow, slashed in full if it votes or attests in bad faith. Since the bond is a fixed absolute amount, N fake personas cost N times that sum up front. An attacker flooding the delta of the reputation ledger must fill a vault with real collateral per puppet, forfeitable on one proven lie, so fraud burns the whole cluster's capital. The sable cost is idle collateral earning nothing. Honest attestation stays cheaper; mass deception pays only by outspending honest agents many times.
